default_env.description: Environment opened when none is given on the command line; a key of environments.yaml.

rate.description: Average live log lines per second per pod. Default 1.

seed.description: Random seed; the same seed gives the same cluster and logs. Default 42.

kafka.description: Limits of the Kafka screen (used only when the folder has kafka/ profiles).

client_id.description: Kafka client id, so the brokers' operators can recognize Huginn. Default huginn.

connect_timeout.description: Time to reach a broker and authenticate before it is reported unreachable, e.g. 10s. Default 10s.

fetch_max_bytes.description: Bytes per fetch response from a broker. Default 1MiB.

isolation.description: Isolation when a Kafka screen opens (key i switches it): read_uncommitted shows every record, read_committed hides aborted transactions. Default read_uncommitted.

max_buffer_bytes.description: Bytes of keys, values and headers kept per Kafka screen; the oldest records are dropped first. A number of bytes or a size such as 64MiB. Default 64MiB.

max_records.description: Records kept in memory per Kafka screen; the oldest are dropped first. Default 20000.

max_value_bytes.description: A larger key or value is kept truncated, with its real size shown. Default 256KiB.

partition_fetch_max_bytes.description: Bytes per partition per fetch response. Default 256KiB.

request_timeout.description: Time allowed for one request to a broker, e.g. 30s. Default 30s.

tail_records.description: Records per partition loaded by the tail (key 0). 1 to 10000. Default 100.

buffer_lines.description: Maximum lines kept in memory per logs screen; older lines are dropped. At least 1000. Default 50000.

repos_root.description: Folder containing your repositories, used by the manifests rule of services.yaml and by {repo_dir} in kafka/. ~ is expanded.

version.description: Structure version of this file; must be 1.

windows.description: Time-window presets of the logs screen.

default.description: Window used when a logs screen opens: a duration such as 15m, tail or head. Default 15m.

head_lines.description: Lines loaded per container by the head window (key 9): the first lines the node keeps. At most logs.buffer_lines. Default 500.

presets.description: Windows bound to keys 1…7, e.g. [15m, 30m, 1h, 1d]; at most 7. Default: 15m 30m 40m 45m 1h 1d 2d.

tail_lines.description: Lines loaded by the tail window (key 0). Default 500.
